CSV of the filtered events. The file's SHA-256 and the filters are written to the audit log first.
Values for the filter drop-downs, limited to what the caller can see.
Latest runs: the newest, and the newest that finished (the banner follows the latter).

post.description: Start a chain verification. One run at a time: a recent unfinished run is returned instead.
Enrolment is mandatory when the role requires MFA and voluntary otherwise.
Sign out everywhere: every session of the caller ends, this one included.
